meta.title: Cluster — Open-source knowledge and training for your company
meta.description: Cluster is an open-source platform for your company's knowledge, training and people. Run it on your own server, in your brand.

hero.subtitle: An open-source knowledge base and training platform for your company, on your own server and in your brand.
hero.titleAccent: within reach of your whole team.

know.name: KNOW
know.description: Pages organized in spaces, written together in real time, with access you decide per space and saved versions you can go back to.
know.point1: Keep related pages together in shared spaces
know.point2: Write with your team and see changes as they happen
know.point3: Choose who can read or edit each space
know.cellPageDesc: Several people on the same page, each with their own cursor.
know.cellAccessDesc: Who can read, edit or manage each space: people, areas or positions.
know.cellMarkdownDesc: Import a page from Markdown and export it back whenever you want.

grow.name: GROW
grow.tagline: Train your team <accent>and track their progress.</accent>
grow.description: Build courses, assign the mandatory ones by area or position, and follow everyone's progress.
grow.point1: Lessons with text, video and files
grow.point2: Quizzes to check what was learned
grow.point4: Progress reports by person, area and course
grow.cellDashboardDesc: Completion by area and the mandatory courses that are due.
grow.cellReportsDesc: Who finished, who is halfway and who has not started. Export it to CSV.
grow.cellCertificateDesc: Every certificate carries a public code.

connect.name: CONNECT
connect.tagline: Your company's structure, <accent>clear and up to date.</accent>
connect.description: A company feed, a directory of everyone and an org chart that shows who works with whom.
connect.point1: Find people by name, role or area
connect.point2: See positions and teams in one directory
connect.point3: Follow reporting lines in the org chart

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Short answers to what HR and People teams ask us most.
faq.a1: Cluster is one place for your people: KNOW for company knowledge, GROW for training and courses, and CONNECT for the feed, directory and org chart. A fourth module, LIFE, is coming later.
faq.q2: Can we run it on our own servers?
faq.a2: Yes. Cluster runs on your own servers or cloud, so your information stays under your control.
faq.a3: English and Spanish (neutral Latin American). Each person chooses their language, and every screen follows it.
faq.q4: Can we turn modules on or off?
faq.a4: Yes. Turn on only what you need, for example KNOW and GROW, and keep the rest off until you want them.
faq.q5: How do we see a demo?
faq.a5: Tell us about your team and we will walk you through Cluster with your own use cases.
faq.a6: Yes. The code is under the MIT licence: you can use it, change it and run it at no cost. The commercial plan adds managed hosting, single sign-on, advanced audit and support.
faq.q7: What do I need to run it?
faq.a7: A server with Docker Compose. The installation guide in the docs walks you through it step by step.

cta.subtitle: Tell us how your company shares knowledge and trains its people, and we'll show you where Cluster fits, on your server or run by us.
